  - **M430a** The Magatama is one of three Kojin treasures; the other two lie in the vault. *The Whims of the Divine* (4.0, main): "The Yasakani-no-Magatama is one of three most coveted treasures of the Kojin. The other two lie within the vault."
  - **M430b** Bunchin's ceremonial knife opens the Kojin vault on the Isle of Zekki. *The Whims of the Divine* (4.0, main): "Before this blade, that which is sealed shall open. The treasure vault of the Kojin, on the Isle of Zekki."
  - **M430c** An attack on the vault would summon Kojin from all around to defend it. *The Whims of the Divine* (4.0, main): "Were the vault to be attacked, their response would by necessity be immediate. Kojin would be summoned from malms around to defend their treasures."
  - **M430d** Without the Kojin, the imperials lack the troops to hold Isari. *The Whims of the Divine* (4.0, main): "Without the Kojin, the imperials don't have nearly enough troops in Isari to hold off the pirates."
  - **M430e** Soroban will tell the Confederacy to be ready to act. *The Whims of the Divine* (4.0, main): "I shall inform the Confederacy of your plans, and bid them make ready to act when the time is right."

</details>

### The Silence of Yanxia (`evt-the-silence-of-yanxia`, event)

**#434 only · main**

> With Isari freed, Gosetsu, still hurt from Grynewaht's interrogation, led you into Yanxia. After crushing Doma's rebellion, Zenos left and named Yotsuyu to rule in his stead, and her purges of the villages ended long ago, but their memory keeps the people in line. Elsewhere, Grynewaht defeated the Red Kojin who abandoned their posts.

Sources shown: A Silence in Three Parts — main scenario quest (4.0)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M434a** Confederate forces drove Yotsuyu from Isari, and the captives survived. *A Silence in Three Parts* (4.0, main): "[[Yotsuyu]] and her imperials have been driven from [[Isari]], and their former captives managed to survive their ordeal."
  - **M434e** Gosetsu is still hurt from Grynewaht's interrogation. *A Silence in Three Parts* (4.0, main): "Despite his assurances, [[Gosetsu]] is clearly still troubled by the injuries he sustained from [[Grynewaht]]'s brutal interrogation."
  - **M434b** Zenos left Doma after crushing the rebellion and named Yotsuyu to serve in his stead. *A Silence in Three Parts* (4.0, main): "[[Zenos]] had no desire to remain in Doma after he crushed the rebellion, and so he named Yotsuyu to serve in his stead."
  - **M434c** The acting viceroy waged an indiscriminate campaign of terror on the villages. *A Silence in Three Parts* (4.0, main): "The acting viceroy waged an indiscriminate campaign of terror, marching into villages without warning"
  - **M434d** The purges ceased, but their memory keeps the people from resisting. *A Silence in Three Parts* (4.0, main): "After a time, these purges ceased, but the memory remains, and with it the promise of punishment should the people resist."
  - **M434f** Grynewaht cuts down the Red Kojin there and destroys most of their treasure. *A Silence in Three Parts* (4.0, main): "''Grynewaht defeats all of the Red Kojin and destroys most of the treasure.''"

</details>

### Lord Hien on the Steppe (`evt-lord-hien-on-the-steppe`, event)

### Aulus (`char-aulus`, character)

**#483 onward · main**

> A Garlean researcher who argued that altering the Garlean genome could let his people wield magicks. Only Zenos supported him; he has treated Fordola and means to test her in the field.

  - **M465e** Alphinaud doubts he can disable the castle's field generators, so he has turned to Cid. *The Room Where It Happened* (4.0, main): "Alphinaud lacks confidence in his ability to disable the field generators"

### Spoils of Liberation (`evt-spoils-of-liberation`, event)

**#502 only · main**

> Ala Mhigo is free but has no leader, and its last king, Theodoric, was called the mad king for good reason. Arenvald has set you and Alphinaud on the trail of the mad king's trove, the wealth Theodoric is said to have hoarded from the kinsmen he executed, which soldiers searching the palace never found.

Sources shown: Arenvald's Adventure — main scenario quest (4.1)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M502a** Lyse says Doma had Lord Hien ready to rule, but Ala Mhigo has no one like him. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "The Domans had Lord Hien ready and willing to take the throne, but we've got no one like that here."
  - **M502b** Theodoric, Ala Mhigo's last ruler, was called the mad king for good reason. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "Theodoric was our last ruler—and he wasn't called the mad king for nothing."
  - **M502e** Theodoric had everyone with a claim to the throne executed, his own family included. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "And so he ordered that every soul with a claim to the throne be executed—including his own family."
  - **M502f** Theodoric is said to have hoarded the wealth of the kinsmen he executed. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "[[King Theodoric]] is reputed to have hoarded the personal wealth of his executed kinsmen"
  - **M502g** Soldiers who searched the palace after the liberation found no treasure. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "But even after scouring every room from dawn till dusk, they uncovered not a single coin."
  - **M502h** Arenvald is set on you and Alphinaud finding the mad king's trove. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "Needless to say, Arenvald is determined that you should be the ones to uncover the mad king's trove."

</details>

**#503 only · main**

> Arenvald has set you and Alphinaud hunting the mad king's trove. Ernold, the old king's head scribe, says Theodoric had his remaining kin cursed into monstrosities and cast into the darkness below the palace, and Alphinaud thinks the tale points to the hiding place. Arenvald, meanwhile, revealed that his father was a Garlean soldier.

Sources shown: Arenvald's Adventure — main scenario quest (4.1); The Darkness Below — main scenario quest (4.1)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M502h** Arenvald is set on you and Alphinaud finding the mad king's trove. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "Needless to say, Arenvald is determined that you should be the ones to uncover the mad king's trove."
  - **M503b** Old Ernold was the king's head scribe. *The Darkness Below* (4.1, main): "ask old Ernold—he was the king's head scribe."
  - **M503c** The king had his court thaumaturge curse the remaining royal family. *The Darkness Below* (4.1, main): "His Majesty ordered the court thaumaturge to unleash a vile curse upon the remaining members of the royal family"
  - **M503d** The cursed monstrosities were cast into the darkness below the palace. *The Darkness Below* (4.1, main): "The resulting...monstrosities were then cast into the darkness below the palace."
  - **M503g** Alphinaud thinks Ernold's tale may show where the trove is hidden. *The Darkness Below* (4.1, main): "Ernold's anecdote may have very well told us where the trove is hidden."
  - **M503e** Arenvald's father was a Garlean soldier. *The Darkness Below* (4.1, main): "My father was in the imperial army, a man of Garlean blood."

</details>

**#504 only · main**

> Following Ernold's tale, Alphinaud reasoned that the darkness below Ala Mhigo's palace is drowned Skalla, where Theodoric cast his cursed kin to guard his treasure. You fought through the sunken city, still haunted by what is left of them, and found the mad king's trove ahead of Alphinaud and Arenvald.

Sources shown: The Darkness Below — main scenario quest (4.1); The Mad King's Trove — main scenario quest (4.1)

  - **M504b** Theodoric had his kin cursed and cast down to guard his treasures. *The Mad King's Trove* (4.1, main): "had his kinsmen cursed and cast into the depths not only to punish them for their imagined crimes, but to have them serve as guardians over his treasures."
  - **M504c** What is left of Theodoric's kin still haunts the drowned city. *The Mad King's Trove* (4.1, main): "'Twould appear this place is yet inhabited by King Theodoric's kin—or what is left of them."

**#505 only · main**

At the Resonatorium you learned why her visions never stop: the imperials fed her aether from many victims to recreate Krile's Echo. Raubahn will keep her alive to learn more. Then Pipin brought word that the sultana wants to see you.

### The Sultana's Bargain (`evt-the-sultanas-bargain`, event)

**#507 only · main**

> Sultana Nanamo slipped out of the palace with you as her advisor, visiting the refugees, the place her parents died and the Coliseum where Raubahn swore her his blade. She wonders whether he will stay in Ul'dah or return to his newly freed homeland. Meanwhile Alphinaud and Arenvald puzzle over how to use the mad king's trove.

Sources shown: A Sultana's Strings — main scenario quest (4.1)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M507a** Alphinaud and Arenvald puzzle over how to use the mad king's treasures. *A Sultana's Strings* (4.1, main): "Well, the question of how to put the mad king's treasures to good use shows no sign of answering itself."
  - **M507b** Nanamo takes you on a private outing as her advisor. *A Sultana's Strings* (4.1, main): "Ordinarily, Papashan would accompany me, but for this particular outing I need an advisor—not a minder."
  - **M507c** No one knows whether the rockslide that killed Nanamo's parents was an accident or an assassination. *A Sultana's Strings* (4.1, main): "To this day, it is not certain if the incident was simple misfortune or an expertly planned assassination."

  - **M507g** Nanamo is unsure whether Raubahn will stay in Ul'dah or return to Ala Mhigo. *A Sultana's Strings* (4.1, main): "Whether Raubahn chooses to remain in Ul'dah or return to Ala Mhigo, I only wish that he do so with a heart unburdened by guilt or regret."

</details>

**#508 only · main**

Godbert, whose counsel she sought at the Gold Saucer, warned that charity breeds dependence, so any aid she pledges must make the refugees self-sufficient.

Sources shown: A Sultana's Strings — main scenario quest (4.1); A Sultana's Duty — main scenario quest (4.1)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

### Ala Mhigo (`loc-ala-mhigo`, location)

**#200–4.0 · main**

> A fallen nation. Raubahn and Ilberd were friends and rivals there before it fell.

Sources shown: Traitor in the Midst — main scenario quest (2.4)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M200e** Raubahn and Ilberd have been friends and rivals since before the fall of Ala Mhigo. *Traitor in the Midst* (2.4, main): "You learn that Raubahn and Ilberd have been friends and rivals since before the fall of [[Ala Mhigo]]."

</details>

**#502–#511 · main**

> A nation in Gyr Abania, newly freed from the Empire. It has no one ready to rule: its last king, Theodoric, was called the mad king for good reason, and had every claimant to the throne executed, his own family included. For now it leans on the Alliance.

Sources shown: Arenvald's Adventure — main scenario quest (4.1)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M502a** Lyse says Doma had Lord Hien ready to rule, but Ala Mhigo has no one like him. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "The Domans had Lord Hien ready and willing to take the throne, but we've got no one like that here."
  - **M502b** Theodoric, Ala Mhigo's last ruler, was called the mad king for good reason. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "Theodoric was our last ruler—and he wasn't called the mad king for nothing."
  - **M502c** For now Ala Mhigo must lean on Raubahn and the Alliance for support. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "For the time being, we're just going to have to keep leaning on General Aldynn and the Alliance for support"
  - **M502e** Theodoric had everyone with a claim to the throne executed, his own family included. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "And so he ordered that every soul with a claim to the throne be executed—including his own family."

</details>

**#512–#529 · main**

> A nation in Gyr Abania, newly freed from the Empire, whose last king, Theodoric, was called the mad king. At its first council the Qalyana summoned Lakshmi in the throne room; afterwards the envoys chose a government of representatives elected by the people, modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons, and Raubahn stays to help rebuild.

Sources shown: Arenvald's Adventure — main scenario quest (4.1); Return of the Bull — main scenario quest (4.1)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M502b** Theodoric, Ala Mhigo's last ruler, was called the mad king for good reason. *Arenvald's Adventure* (4.1, main): "Theodoric was our last ruler—and he wasn't called the mad king for nothing."
  - **M512b** The Qalyana broodmother summons an incarnation of Sri Lakshmi in the throne room. *Return of the Bull* (4.1, main): "the Qalyana broodmother somehow summons forth an incarnation of [[Lakshmi|Sri Lakshmi]], plunging the throne room into chaos."
  - **M512h** The envoys choose an elected government modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons. *Return of the Bull* (4.1, main): "The envoys have chosen to instate a government modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons─a ruling body of representatives elected by the people."
  - **M512i** Nanamo tells Raubahn to stay and rebuild his homeland. *Return of the Bull* (4.1, main): "Stay here, in your homeland. Work with your brethren. Rebuild Ala Mhigo!"

</details>

**#530–#535 · main**

> A nation in Gyr Abania, freed from the Empire and now governed by elected representatives. Its council has made the Resistance its standing army, and Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance, which held a council there on the Ascian threat.

Sources shown: Return of the Bull — main scenario quest (4.1); Tidings from the East — main scenario quest (4.2); Sisterly Act — main scenario quest (4.4); Shadows in the Empire — main scenario quest (4.4)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M512h** The envoys choose an elected government modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons. *Return of the Bull* (4.1, main): "The envoys have chosen to instate a government modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons─a ruling body of representatives elected by the people."
  - **M513a** The council recognizes the Resistance as Ala Mhigo's standing army. *Tidings from the East* (4.2, main): "The council has officially recognized the Resistance as our standing army."
  - **M528a** A council in Ala Mhigo will weigh how to combat the Ascians. *Sisterly Act* (4.4, main): "a council is to be held in [[Ala Mhigo]] to deliberate how best to combat the [[Ascian]] menace"
  - **M530c** Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance. *Shadows in the Empire* (4.4, main): "Right, so, the big news is that Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance."

</details>

**#536–#537 · main**

> A free nation of Gyr Abania and a member of the Eorzean Alliance. Garlean defectors of the Populares have fled there, and one, Maxima, warns that the Empire is marching west; Raubahn has asked the Alliance for reinforcements.

Sources shown: Shadows in the Empire — main scenario quest (4.4); Soul Searching — main scenario quest (4.5); A Defector's Tidings — main scenario quest (4.5)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M530c** Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance. *Shadows in the Empire* (4.4, main): "Right, so, the big news is that Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance."
  - **M535d** Populares have defected to Ala Mhigo, Maxima among them. *Soul Searching* (4.5, main): "Apparently, a group of Populares have defected to Ala Mhigo, and Maxima─the envoy Alphinaud left with─is one of them!"
  - **M536f** Maxima judges the Empire is mobilizing for a large-scale war. *A Defector's Tidings* (4.5, main): "It is my assessment that the Empire's forces are mobilizing for a large-scale military engagement."
  - **M536g** Raubahn asks the Alliance's leaders for reinforcements. *A Defector's Tidings* (4.5, main): "Dispatch messengers to the Alliance leadership requesting reinforcements."

</details>

**#538 onward · main**

> A free nation of Gyr Abania and a member of the Eorzean Alliance, which has camped near its northeastern border. A parley there with Emperor Varis failed, and the Empire means to meet the Alliance next on the battlefield.

Sources shown: Shadows in the Empire — main scenario quest (4.4); Parley on the Front Lines — main scenario quest (4.5)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M530c** Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance. *Shadows in the Empire* (4.4, main): "Right, so, the big news is that Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance."
  - **M538a** The Alliance has a base camp near Ala Mhigo's northeastern border. *Parley on the Front Lines* (4.5, main): "The Alliance has established a base camp near Ala Mhigo’s northeastern border."
  - **M538j** Varis ends the talks; their next meeting will not be at a table. *Parley on the Front Lines* (4.5, main): "This discussion is at an end. I bid you make ready for our next meeting. It will not be at the negotiating table."

</details>
